decision.observation: Car still at 1 mph in gear 1, red X cleared, dots dark. A pale tree trunk runs straight down the view and its base sits right at the car's nose — the car looks pinned against it, which explains the failed throttle. The tarmac with its posts and blue puddles lies to the screen-right and below, along the lower-right diagonal.
decision.hypothesis: The nose is jammed on the trunk ahead rather than stalled; throttle alone will keep yielding nothing. Plain reverse should back it off, after which a right-steered hold can drop it onto the tarmac below-right.
decision.memory: When forward throttle moves the car barely at all (1 mph) with a trunk touching the bonnet, treat it as pinned and reverse first, even if the earlier pin looked like a mere stall.
